items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: I don’t know how you rate Toshiko Akiyoshi, but as far as I’m concerned she’s an excellent writer and she gets a lot of great sounds, chords and textures out of that band.

ctx.x: No, not necessarily doing the Basie thing, but in other words, just putting your thumb on the pulse and saying, are the traditions alive and well?

Yeah, I would say the traditions are alive and well. Illinois Jacquet has a band that’s a very good band, and of course he’s from the old school, and the arrangements are from that same school. And a lot of the guys are in that generation, mixed with younger guys, really doing very well. And there are some bands around New York, well I don’t know how you rate Toshiko Akiyoshi, but as far as I’m concerned she’s an excellent writer and she gets a lot of great sounds, chords and textures out of that band. How often does that band play though?
